proof.label: Sample

reviews.text: The dryer in our basement ran for an hour and the towels came out damp and cold. He had the back off in ten minutes, showed me the burnt thermal fuse in his palm and had it running before my coffee was done.
reviews.name: Kendra L.

reviews.text: Fridge was at 51 degrees on a Sunday night. I called Monday at eight, read them the model number off the tag inside the door, and the tech showed up with the defrost heater already in the van.
reviews.name: Omar S.

reviews.text: Straight talk about a 14-year-old washer: he said the transmission job would cost more than half of a new machine and told us not to do it. Charged the visit and nothing else.
reviews.name: Patty W.

reviews.text: Dishwasher full of gray water. Filter packed with lemon seeds, pump checked anyway to be sure. Twenty minutes and we were back to clean glasses.
reviews.name: Derek H.

reviews.text: Oven took forty minutes to reach 350 and the igniter glowed a weak orange. He replaced it, then ran the oven with a thermometer inside to prove it held temperature. Thanksgiving went fine.
reviews.name: Luz M.

reviews.text: Moved into a 1958 ranch and the washer hookup in the basement had rubber hoses from who knows when. They installed the new washer, put in braided lines and leveled it on that uneven floor.
reviews.name: Grant T.

proof.guarantee: If the part we replaced fails within 90 days, we come back and fix it at no charge.
